controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-11T07:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-11T11:00:00.000Z"
        AND host.name == "soc-playground"
| STATS events = COUNT(*)
        BY falco.rule, falco.output_fields.container.id, falco.output_fields.proc.name, falco.output_fields.proc.pname, falco.output_fields.proc.cmdline
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 50
